project.name: Runner — Chrome recorder bridge
project.description:
The local development adapter behind RecorderBrowser: a Chrome child process driven over the DevTools Protocol.
This is the direct analogue of LocalJmeterExecutionProvider (CLAUDE.md §15). It uses ProcessBuilder, so it is permitted only under a local/development profile; the shared-runner profile puts the browser in a recorder Pod behind the same port. Commands are passed as an argument list and never as a shell string.
The user never reaches this module's protocol surface. It accepts the fixed RecorderInputKind vocabulary and translates it; there is no path from an API request to an arbitrary DevTools command. See docs/architecture/recorder-security-review.md §4.4.
No new dependency: the WebSocket client is java.net.http from the JDK, and Jackson is already used elsewhere in the reactor.
